# Psionics
[color=#a4885c]Psionics[/color] are a rare, measurable neurological phenomenon found in several sapient species. They are not caused by the Turning: recorded psions exist outside Crescent, and the earliest known cases predate the sector's settlement.
Modern researchers describe the phenomenon through [color=#a4885c]noetic resonance[/color], but no faction has a complete theory. Scientific, spiritual, and practical interpretations can produce useful techniques without any one of them proving what psionics ultimately is.
## Power scaling
- [color=#a4885c]Potentia[/color] measures raw psionic potential. - [color=#ff4500]Amplification (kα)[/color] measures projected strength. - [color=#87cefa]Dampening (kδ)[/color] measures control, containment, and resistance to uncontrolled spillover.
Using powers contributes to local Glimmer. Greater Amplification generally produces stronger effects and more Glimmer, while Dampening reduces spillover. Psions are not automatic superweapons: training, medical oversight, conventional teammates, and protection still matter, and mature countermeasures can isolate, suppress, drug, exhaust, or kill a gifted target.
## Psionic potential
Characters with a caster trait possess a psionic skill tree. Most begin at psionic level 1 with one development point. Use the [bold]Psionic Development[/bold] action to inspect the tree and unlock a power. Unlocking an active power adds its own button to the action bar.
Latent Psychics can inspect all six primary disciplines: Fire, Veil, Life, Mind, Kinetic, and Defense. The first root they unlock becomes their permanent primary discipline and locks the other five. Specialist traits expose only their associated discipline. Each later node requires the preceding node, the listed psionic level, and a development point.
[color=#a4885c]Recurrence[/color] is a separate advanced branch and is not a primary discipline, so choosing one does not lock it. Its first node needs psionic level 2, and the branch runs Stasis Field, Reweave, and Recurrence Pulse.
Naturals are rare individuals with an innate telepathic voice. Not every psionic entity has telepathy, and an apparently human voice is no proof of identity.
Telepathy is used by starting a message with the [bold]=[/bold] sign. The user must be alive and conscious, but ordinary muteness does not prevent it. Telepathic messages are anonymous, so trust them carefully.
## Psionic development
Potentia measures progress toward the next psionic level. Initial sensitivity, certain powerful hallucinogens, and noetic events can grant Potentia. Crossing the threshold spends the required Potentia, increases psionic level by one, and grants one development point; it does not select a random power.
Next Level Threshold = Baseline Power Cost × 2^(current psionic level - 1)
For a standard level 1 psion, successive thresholds are 100, 200, 400, and 800 Potentia. A Psycho-Historian begins with Telepathy, no unspent point, and a lower baseline cost of 75, allowing faster progression within the Mind discipline. Development is never medically trivial; seizures, instability, unwanted attention, and factional control are all credible consequences.
## Faction approaches
- [bold]Divine Sol Mandate.[/bold] The House of Questions registers, evaluates, licenses, and monitors useful psions for supervised service. - [bold]Workers' Union and NCWL.[/bold] Psions enter trained cadres and medical oversight. Revolutionary doctrine rejects treating a gifted person as private property, while military authority still controls deployment. - [bold]Shinohara Heavy Industries.[/bold] Psions are scarce specialists with contracts, risk classifications, medical files, and market value. - [bold]TFCF.[/bold] GSC uses combat and boarding specialists; Interdyne handles clinical support; Cyberdawn develops intelligence and countermeasures; SAW applies useful talents to recovery and shipboard work. - [bold]Taypani-Atyrian Pact.[/bold] The Arabet preserve Crescent's deepest formal psionic tradition, while gifted people appear across all four families. - [bold]Gliess Santo.[/bold] Ability is regulated like a weapon: possession is not itself a crime, but harmful use without lawful cause is. - [bold]Saint's Militia.[/bold] The Militia hunts psions instead of fielding them, rejecting government licenses and corporate contracts alike.
## Noetic entities
Epistemic traditions use names such as [color=#a4885c]Sophia[/color] and [color=#a4885c]Oracle[/color] for recurring noetic manifestations. Researchers, psions, and believers disagree over whether these are independent entities, interfaces, collective projections, or something else. Their observable gameplay effects do not settle that argument.
## Anti-psionic practice
Suppression is a mature field. Specialized ammunition, drugs, restraints, sensor techniques, null-producing traits or equipment, and trained counter-psionic personnel reduce a gifted target's advantage. The most reliable response is combined arms: identify the ability, deny the conditions it needs, and apply conventional force while the target is constrained.
